text: Our lamp is dead. A safety lamp hangs by the bunks, up in the barracks. Bring it, and I will chalk you a short way.
Somebody fell up there. Please. Somebody help them.
Jakub? Jakub Ostrowski, you are alive? We thought the gallery had you.
Another one begins. I can hear it in the timbers.
They are walking overhead again. Stay low, boys. Stay low.
Quiet. They hear boots. We are three, and we have been in the dark since the bell.
Eleven years I worked this seam. I know every gallery. I do not know what walks in them now.
A real flame. God bless you. Here, the chalk. Follow my marks, and you will shorten your walk.
